name: ibvap
description: Intelligent Border Video Analytics Platform — Tactical Surveillance Command Interface

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), mime = {'.html':'text/html','.css':'text/css','.js':'application/javascript','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}; http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, 'frontend', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.split('?')[0]); fs.readFile(p, (err, data) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } else { res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(p)] || 'text/plain' }); res.end(data); } }); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('IBVAP Console running on http://localhost:8080'));"

author: IBVAP Team
